content: Phase 1: POC payment core (webhook + atomic stock + idempotent orders) — 5/5 passed
Phase 2: Full 52-route customer app + mocked auth + backend catalog APIs — testing 100%
Phase 3a: Wire Real Catalog — 85 products + 9 hampers + 7 categories seeded from user Excel, all pages fetch /api/catalog/* — testing 100%
Phase 3b: Wire checkout to Phase 1 payment core (real backend order + webhook confirmation flow)
Phase 3c: Backend JWT auth endpoints + per-user order API
Phase 4: My Account/Tracking/Returns backed by real per-user data
Phase 6: AI Gift Advisor + Nano Banana hamper image generation
Phase 7: Firebase + Razorpay swap-in, rate limiting, mobile QA 375/768/1440
